task: If I ___ her number, I would call her right now. (know)
correct answer: knew
explanation shown to learner: An imagined present: *if* + past (*knew*), not *would*.
explanation in Latvian: Iedomāta tagadne: *if* + pagātne (*knew*), nevis *would*. *Tulkojot burtiski* "ja es zinātu", *gribas would*, bet aiz *if* tā nav.

task: If the train ___ faster, more people would use it for work. (be)
correct answer: was | were
explanation shown to learner: An imagined present: *if* + past (*knew*), not *would*.
explanation in Latvian: Iedomāta tagadne: *if* + pagātne (*knew*), nevis *would*. *Tulkojot burtiski* "ja es zinātu", *gribas would*, bet aiz *if* tā nav.

task: I ___ more if the gym were closer to my office. (exercise)
correct answer: would exercise | 'd exercise | might exercise | could exercise
explanation shown to learner: The result of an imagined present: *would* (or *could, might*) + base form.
explanation in Latvian: Iedomātas tagadnes sekas: *would* (vai *could, might*) + pamatforma.

topic: Third conditional (if + had done, would have done)
task: If we ___ earlier, we wouldn't have missed the flight. (leave)
correct answer: had left | 'd left
explanation shown to learner: An imagined past: *if* + *had* + 3rd form, not *would have*.
explanation in Latvian: Iedomāta pagātne: *if + had* + 3. forma, nevis *would have*.

topic: Third conditional (if + had done, would have done)
task: If you had asked me, I ___ you with the move. (help)
correct answer: would have helped | 'd have helped | might have helped | could have helped
explanation shown to learner: The result in an imagined past: *would have* (or *could have, might have*) + 3rd form.
explanation in Latvian: Sekas iedomātā pagātnē: *would have* (vai *could have, might have*) + 3. forma.

task: 'I'll send the report tomorrow.' Tom said he ___ the report the next day. (send)
correct answer: would send | 'd send
explanation shown to learner: Reported later: *will* becomes *would*.
explanation in Latvian: Atstāstot vēlāk, *will* kļūst par *would*.
replaces: Tom said he ___ the report the next day. (send)

task: 'I've lived here for two years.' She told me she ___ there for two years. (live)
correct answer: had lived | had been living | 'd lived | 'd been living
explanation shown to learner: Reported later: *have lived* becomes *had lived* (or *had been living*).
explanation in Latvian: Atstāstot vēlāk, *have lived* kļūst par *had lived* (vai *had been living*).
replaces: She told me she ___ in Riga for two years. (live)

task: The receptionist asked me where I ___ from. (be)
correct answer: was
explanation shown to learner: A reported question: statement order and one step back in time: *where I was from*.
explanation in Latvian: Atstāstītā jautājumā: *apgalvojuma* secība un laiks soli atpakaļ: *where I was from*.

task: She asked me how long I ___ English. (study)
correct answer: had been studying | had studied | 'd been studying | 'd studied
explanation shown to learner: A reported question: one step back in time: *had been studying*.
explanation in Latvian: Atstāstītā jautājumā laiks soli atpakaļ: *had been studying*.

topic: Indirect questions (Could you tell me where...)
task: Could you tell me what time the museum ___ on Sundays? (open)
correct answer: opens
explanation shown to learner: The embedded question has subject before verb and no *does*: *what time the museum opens*.
explanation in Latvian: Netiešajā jautājumā teikuma priekšmets ir pirms darbības vārda, un nav *does*: *what time the museum opens*.
replaces: Could you tell me what time the museum ___? (open)
column14: will be open :: Correct when asking about future opening hours. :: Pareizi, jautājot par darba laiku nākotnē.

topic: Narrative tenses with past perfect continuous
task: When I finally got through, I ___ on hold for forty minutes. (wait)
correct answer: had been waiting | 'd been waiting | had waited | 'd waited
explanation shown to learner: How long something went on before a moment in the past: *had been* + *-ing*.
explanation in Latvian: Cik ilgi kaut kas notika līdz kādam brīdim pagātnē: *had been + -ing*.

topic: Contrast, purpose and reason (although, despite, so that)
task: ___ her knee injury, she finished the marathon.
correct answer: Despite
wrong options / checks: bank: Despite | Although | Even though | Despite of
explanation shown to learner: *Despite* + noun (*her knee injury*); *although* and *even though* need subject + verb, and *despite* has no *of*.
explanation in Latvian: *Despite* + lietvārds (*her knee injury*); aiz *although* un *even though* vajag teikuma priekšmetu un darbības vārdu, un *despite* lieto bez *of*.
replaces: ___ the rain, we finished the hike.

topic: Contrast, purpose and reason (although, despite, so that)
task: I set two alarms in order ___ my early flight. (not / miss)
correct answer: not to miss | to not miss | that I don't miss | that I do not miss | that I won't miss | that I will not miss | that I wouldn't miss | that I would not miss
explanation shown to learner: Purpose, negative: *in order not to* + base form.
explanation in Latvian: Nolūks noliegumā: *in order not to* + pamatforma.
replaces: She wrote everything down so as ___ anything. (not / forget)

topic: Contrast, purpose, reason and result (whereas, in case, therefore)
task: I'll leave you my number in case you ___ any problems with the flat. (have)
correct answer: have | should have | happen to have | do have
explanation shown to learner: After *in case* the present (or *should*), not *will*.
explanation in Latvian: Aiz *in case* tagadne (vai *should*), nevis *will*.
replaces: Take an umbrella in case it ___ later. (rain)

topic: Third conditional (if + had done, would have done)
task: I would have gone to the concert if I ___ about it. (know)
correct answer: had known | 'd known
explanation shown to learner: An imagined past: *if* + *had* + 3rd form, not *would have*.
explanation in Latvian: Iedomāta pagātne: *if + had* + 3. forma, nevis *would have*.

topic: Third conditional (if + had done, would have done)
task: If she hadn't checked the code, the app ___ . (crash)
correct answer: would have crashed | 'd have crashed | might have crashed | could have crashed
explanation shown to learner: The result in an imagined past: *would have* + 3rd form.
explanation in Latvian: *Sekas* iedomātā pagātnē: *would have* + 3. forma.

task: The doctor told me ___ anything heavy for a week. (not / lift)
correct answer: not to lift
explanation shown to learner: A reported instruction: *told me not to* + base form.
explanation in Latvian: Atstāstīts norādījums: *told me not to* + pamatforma.

task: She apologised ___ the meeting without a word. (leave)
correct answer: for leaving | for having left
explanation shown to learner: *apologise for* + *-ing* (or *having* + 3rd form).
explanation in Latvian: *apologise for* + darbības vārds ar *-ing* (vai *having* + 3. forma).
replaces: He apologised ___ late for the meeting. (be)

task: Our guide suggested ___ the museum early to avoid the queues. (visit)
correct answer: visiting | that we visit | we visit | that we should visit | we should visit | that we visited | we visited | our visiting | going to visit
explanation shown to learner: *suggest* + *-ing* (or *suggest that we visit / should visit*), never *suggest to*.
explanation in Latvian: *suggest* + darbības vārds ar *-ing* (vai *suggest that we visit / should visit*), nekad *suggest to*.
replaces: My colleague suggested ___ a taxi to the airport. (take)

topic: Indirect questions, more uses (I don't know what to do)
task: I'm not sure what time the meeting ___ tomorrow. (start)
correct answer: starts | will start | is going to start | is starting | is to start | is due to start
explanation shown to learner: Inside a sentence the question has statement order, without *does*: *what time the meeting starts / will start tomorrow*.
explanation in Latvian: Teikuma iekšienē jautājumam ir *apgalvojuma* secība, bez *does*: *what time the meeting starts / will start tomorrow*.
replaces: I'm not sure what time the meeting ___ . (start)

topic: Narrative tenses with past perfect continuous
task: She was smiling when I saw her, but her eyes were red because she ___ . (cry)
correct answer: had been crying | 'd been crying | had cried | 'd cried
explanation shown to learner: The crying was over before that moment and we see its result: *had been* + *-ing* (*had cried* is also possible).
explanation in Latvian: Raudāšana bija beigusies pirms tā brīža, un mēs redzam tās rezultātu: *had been* + *-ing* (iespējams arī *had cried*).
replaces: Her eyes were red because she ___ . (cry)

task: If I had learned to drive at eighteen, I ___ so much on taxis now. (not / spend)
correct answer: wouldn't spend | would not spend | wouldn't be spending | would not be spending | might not spend
explanation shown to learner: A past event with a result now: *would* + base form, because of *now*.
explanation in Latvian: Pagātnes notikums ar sekām tagad: *would* + pamatforma, jo ir *now*.
replaces: If I had studied medicine, I ___ a doctor now. (be)

task: If I ___ allergic to cats, I would have stayed at Anna's place last weekend. (not / be)
correct answer: weren't | wasn't | were not | was not | hadn't been | had not been
explanation shown to learner: A lasting fact now (*allergic*) with a result in the past: *if* + past (*weren't*). *hadn't been* is also correct if you think only of last weekend.
explanation in Latvian: Pastāvīgs fakts tagad (*allergic*) ar sekām pagātnē: *if* + pagātne (*weren't*). Pareizi arī *hadn't been*, ja domā tikai par pagājušo nedēļas nogali.
replaces: If I ___ so shy, I would have spoken to her at the party. (not / be)

topic: Contrast, purpose, reason and result (whereas, in case, therefore)
task: Sales fell sharply; ___ , the company cut its prices.
correct answer: therefore | as a result | consequently | thus | as a consequence | accordingly | hence | for this reason | in response | because of this
explanation shown to learner: A result as a new step after a semicolon: *therefore*, *as a result*.
explanation in Latvian: Rezultāts kā jauns *solis* aiz *semikola*: *therefore, as a result*.

task: If she ___ the job in London, she would be living there now. (accept)
correct answer: had accepted | 'd accepted
explanation shown to learner: A past event with a result now: *if* + *had* + 3rd form.
explanation in Latvian: Pagātnes notikums ar sekām tagad: *if + had* + 3. forma.

task: I wish I ___ closer to my office; the commute takes hours. (live)
correct answer: lived | could live | was living | were living
explanation shown to learner: A wish about now: *wish* + past (*could live* is also correct).
explanation in Latvian: Vēlēšanās par tagadni: *wish* + pagātne (pareizi arī *could live*).
replaces: I wish I ___ more time to travel this year. (have)

task: I wish I ___ that comment in the meeting yesterday. (not / make)
correct answer: hadn't made | had not made
explanation shown to learner: Regret about the past: *wish* + *had* + 3rd form.
explanation in Latvian: Nožēla par pagātni: *wish + had* + 3. forma.

task: We'll start at nine unless the speaker ___ late. (be)
correct answer: is | 's
explanation shown to learner: *unless* already means *if … not*: no second *not*.
explanation in Latvian: *unless* jau nozīmē *if* … *not*: otru noliegumu *neliek*. *Tulkojot burtiski* "ja *vien* nekavēsies", iznāk divi *noliegumi*.

task: ___ we left ten minutes earlier, we would have caught the ferry. (have)
correct answer: Had
explanation shown to learner: Formal, without *if*: *Had we left* = *If we had left*.
explanation in Latvian: Formāli, bez *if*: *Had we left* = *If we had left*.
replaces: ___ I known about the strike, I would have booked another flight. (have)

topic: Unreal time and preferences (it's high time, I'd rather)
task: It's high time the government ___ something about housing. (do)
correct answer: did | was doing
explanation shown to learner: *It's (high) time* + subject + past: it should already happen.
explanation in Latvian: *It's* (*high*) *time* + teikuma priekšmets + pagātne: tam jau vajadzētu *notikt*.

topic: Unreal time and preferences (it's high time, I'd rather)
task: In future, I'd rather you ___ my phone without asking. (not / use)
correct answer: didn't use | did not use | not use
explanation shown to learner: *I'd rather* + another person + past: what I want someone else not to do. *In future* shows it is about from now on.
explanation in Latvian: *I'd rather* + cita persona + pagātne: ko es gribu, lai cits nedara. *In future* rāda, ka runa ir par turpmāko laiku.
replaces: I'd rather you ___ my phone without asking. (not / use)

task: My father insisted ___ us to the airport. (drive)
correct answer: on driving | that he drive | that he should drive | he should drive | that he would drive | he would drive | that he'd drive | he'd drive
explanation shown to learner: *insist on* + *-ing* (or *insist that he drive / should drive*).
explanation in Latvian: *insist on* + darbības vārds ar *-ing* (vai *insist that he drive / should drive*).
replaces: She insisted ___ for the whole dinner. (pay)

topic: Indirect questions, more uses (I don't know what to do)
task: We couldn't decide where ___ on holiday. (go)
correct answer: to go | we should go | we could go | we would go | we'd go | we were going to go | we ought to go | we were going | we wanted to go | we were to go
explanation shown to learner: Not knowing what to do: question word + *to* + base form.
explanation in Latvian: *Nezinot*, ko darīt: jautājamais vārds + to + pamatforma. *Tulkojot burtiski* "kur *mums braukt*", iznāk jautājuma secība.

task: ___ I in your position, I would ask for a pay rise. (be)
correct answer: Were
explanation shown to learner: Formal, without *if*: *Were I* (not *Was I*).
explanation in Latvian: Formāli, bez *if*: *Were I* (nevis *Was I*).

task: If it ___ for your advice, I would never have applied. (not / be)
correct answer: hadn't been | had not been | weren't | were not | wasn't | was not
explanation shown to learner: *If it hadn't been for* + noun = without it, in the past.
explanation in Latvian: *If it hadn't been for* + lietvārds = bez tā, pagātnē.

task: The minister denied ___ the report before it was published. (see)
correct answer: having seen | seeing | that he had seen | he had seen | that he'd seen | he'd seen | that he saw | he saw
explanation shown to learner: *deny* + *-ing* (or *having* + 3rd form).
explanation in Latvian: *deny + -ing* (vai *having* + 3. forma).

task: They accused the company ___ the data of its users. (sell)
correct answer: of selling | of having sold
explanation shown to learner: *accuse someone of* + *-ing*.
explanation in Latvian: *accuse someone of + -ing*. *Tulkojot burtiski* "apsūdzēja par", *gribas for*.

topic: Indirect questions, more uses (I don't know what to do)
task: ___ wins the competition will get a trip to Lisbon. (who)
correct answer: Whoever | Anyone who | Anybody who | The person who | Everyone who
explanation shown to learner: *Whoever* = it does not matter who: the person who.
explanation in Latvian: *Whoever* = nav svarīgi, kurš: tas, kurš.

topic: Indirect questions, more uses (I don't know what to do)
task: Our holiday plans depend on ___ my boss gives me the week off or not.
correct answer: whether
explanation shown to learner: After a preposition use *whether*, not *if*: *depend on whether ... or not*.
explanation in Latvian: Aiz prievārda lieto *whether*, nevis *if*: *depend on whether ... or not* (vai ... vai ne).
replaces: It depends on ___ the budget is approved or not.

topic: Unreal time and preferences (it's high time, I'd rather)
task: It's about time you ___ to the dentist. (go)
correct answer: went
explanation shown to learner: *It's about time* + subject + past.
explanation in Latvian: *It's about time* + teikuma priekšmets + pagātne.

task: If only I ___ my passport at home! (not / leave)
correct answer: hadn't left | had not left
explanation shown to learner: Regret about the past: *If only* + *had* + 3rd form.
explanation in Latvian: Nožēla par pagātni: *If only + had* + 3. forma.
